ops.statement: When a triage document claims 'pooling recovers monotone ladder', note WHICH estimator produced the result (gate FE vs production solver). Gate-FE and production compound_prior solver are different designs with different identification properties. Downstream work may rediscover this if the triage is ambiguous.

When regenerating gold compound_prior artifacts, only commit compound_prior_summary.json and compound_prior_summary.txt. Diagnostic CSV and PNG files can exceed 50-300MB and must NOT be committed to PRs.
